# Đạo Đồ build pieces: el-tho (generated by tools/design/world/depth_tree.py index)

Organised by **idea** (the tree's big clusters, `design/dao-do/big-cluster-ideas-v5.md`), nearest to the start first, then the small clusters. For each piece: its theme lines and capability, then every notable and keystone in it with its exact lines and, for an Effect, the rule. **Targets** = the ids of the notables / keystone you want from a piece, nearest first (the route opens the small nodes between). `d` = points from the start (tho). Check routes with `python -I tools/design/world/depth_tree.py route <key>`.

## Keystones of this land (a build's capstone: big lines, one rule, and a closing cost)
- **8999** Layered Earth (Hậu Thổ Tích): block_rating 75, defense_pct 20; effect: Layered Earth (Hậu Thổ Tích); closes: your evade counts nothing; rule: Each hit you block raises your defence by 3 % until the fight ends, cap +30. Closes: your evade counts nothing.; ends: block, body (d 9)
- **9009** Mountain's Weight (Sơn Nhạc Trọng): khi_huyet_pct 50, attack_pct 30[tho]; effect: Mountain's Weight (Sơn Nhạc Trọng); closes: art speed −20 % (`art_speed_pct` −20); rule: Your hits deal L5 +4 for each 10 % of maximum health you hold above the foe's, cap +32. Closes: art speed -20 %.; ends: big health, heavy hitter (d 17)
- **9010** Earthen Armour (Thổ Giáp): body_shield_pct 58.8, defense_pct 20; effect: Earthen Armour (Thổ Giáp); closes: maximum linh lực −20 % (`linh_luc_pct` −20); rule: After 3 s without being hit, your body shield refills 10 % a pulse. Closes: maximum linh lực -20 %.; ends: body shield (d 17)
- **3726** Open Sky (Không Thiên): defense_pct 30, ward_efficiency_pct 20; effect: Open Sky (Không Thiên); closes: artifact power -30 %; rule: Your wards are 5 % stronger for each extra item slot you leave empty. Closes (tree keystone): artifact power -30 %.; ends: ward caster (d 21)
- **3727** No Ward (Vô Hộ): khi_huyet_pct 50, block_rating 50; effect: No Ward (Vô Hộ); closes: no ward of any kind; rule: You can never use a ward, and your body hardens instead: body shield +25 %; after each pulse in which no hit reached your health, the body shield regains 2 % of maximum health. Closes: no ward of any kind.; ends: body, thể tu (d 21)
- **3838** Immovable Mountain (Bất Động Sơn): attack_pct 22.5[slow], khi_huyet_pct 25, block_rating 25, resist_pct 312[physical]; effect: Immovable Mountain (Bất Động Sơn); closes: art speed modifiers do nothing; rule: Slowed Time and timer delays never land on you. Closes: art speed modifiers do nothing for you.; ends: slow, heavy hitter (d 21)
- **3839** Earth Vein Tap (Địa Mạch Dẫn): formation_power_pct 25, linh_luc_regen_inc_pct 31.2; effect: Earth Vein Tap (Địa Mạch Dẫn); closes: no linh lực regeneration while no formation of yours stands; rule: While your own formation stands, linh lực regeneration +50 % increased; with none, none.
